resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Many obstruction arguments exhibit a localized failure mode that appears irreducible at the layer where it is first visible; this paper studies one audited route by which such needle obstructions cease to be obstructions, namely passage to a higher layer where additional admissible dissolving probes are available. The framework is the formed-layer membrane setting: zero-energy directions are removed by a legal quotient, native probes are assigned a quadratic native currency, unexplained dissolving currency is measured by an adequacy residual, and predictive membranes, dissolving transport records, and the all-six taxonomy control the transfer. The layer-dissolving endpoint theorem shows that, under predictive native bounds, residual bounds, and transport hypotheses, the dissolving currency is bounded uniformly across accepted stages, so no layer-dissolving predictive needles exist within the declared scope. The complementary duality-confinement membrane theorem shows that, under a separating anti-invariant readout and a vanishing-trace sequence of domination records, visible object mass is confined to the fixed locus of the involution. These are framework-bound dissolution results, not a universal singularity-elimination theorem or a claim about any named external problem. The adequacy-residual calculus on which the layer-dissolving endpoint depends is developed in .

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Given two probe families on the same finite-dimensional carrier, this paper asks what a dissolving family D measures beyond what a native family L can explain under an audit energy C . Under the standing legal-energy quotient and null-mode legality hypotheses, the adequacy residual _C(D L) is the Schur-complement leftover built from the block currencies K_ LL , K_ DD , K_ DL , and K_ LD . We develop this residual as a calculus: the projection identity identifies it with T_D(I-P_L)T_D^* in energy-scaled coordinates; optimality and exact adequacy characterize Loewner minimality and zero residual; promotion combines native and residual budgets into a dissolving budget; and chain-rule, data-processing, and transfer laws describe native extension, post-processing, coarsening, and exact or defective bridges. The blind-spot witness theorem turns failure of a declared residual budget into an explicit recombination vector with positive excess. The paper does not claim exact adequacy generically, does not classify all probe-family pairs, and does not claim novelty for the classical operator-theoretic constructions it packages. A layer-dissolving use of the calculus is given in .
